answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry
answer.trigger: An email with a supplier invoice from Plumbing World arrives.
steps: Extract the invoice details including reference number and amount.
Draft a new supplier bill in the accounts system.
Review the drafted bill details for accuracy.
Approve and save the bill in the accounts system.
answer.ai_help: Read the incoming invoice email and extract the bill details like reference and amount.
answer.human_approval: Emma reviews and approves the drafted bill before it is finally saved in the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect amounts or supplier details could lead to financial errors or duplicate payments.
